AddUserToVpcEndpointService.description_en: Adds a user account to the service whitelist of an endpoint service
AddUserToVpcEndpointService.description_zh: 调用AddUserToVpcEndpointService接口，为终端节点服务添加服务白名单

AddZoneToVpcEndpoint.description_en: Adds a zone to an endpoint
AddZoneToVpcEndpoint.description_zh: 调用AddZoneToVpcEndpoint接口，为终端节点添加可用区

AttachResourceToVpcEndpointService.description_en: Adds a service resource to an endpoint service by calling the AttachResourceToVpcEndpointService operation
AttachResourceToVpcEndpointService.description_zh: 调用AttachResourceToVpcEndpointService接口，为终端节点服务添加服务资源

AttachSecurityGroupToVpcEndpoint.description_en: Calls the AttachSecurityGroupToVpcEndpoint operation to add an endpoint to a security group
AttachSecurityGroupToVpcEndpoint.description_zh: 调用AttachSecurityGroupToVpcEndpoint接口，将终端节点加入安全组

CheckProductOpen.description_en: Calls the CheckProductOpen operation to query whether PrivateLink is activated
CheckProductOpen.description_zh: 调用CheckProductOpen接口，查询是否已开通私网连接

CreateVpcEndpointService.description_en: Calls the CreateVpcEndpointService operation to create an endpoint service
CreateVpcEndpointService.description_zh: 调用CreateVpcEndpointService接口，创建终端节点服务

DeleteVpcEndpoint.description_zh: 调用DeleteVpcEndpoint接口，删除终端节点

DeleteVpcEndpointService.description_zh: 调用DeleteVpcEndpointService接口，删除终端节点服务

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the regions that support PrivateLink
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 调用 DescribeRegions 接口，查询 PrivateLink 私网连接支持的地域列表

DescribeZones.description_en: Queries the list of zones supported by PrivateLink in a specified region. In cross-region scenarios, the zones supported on the endpoint side and the endpoint service side are independent of each other. This operation allows you to query the supported zones for the endpoint side and the endpoint service side separately
DescribeZones.description_zh: 调用 DescribeZones 接口，查询指定地域中 PrivateLink 私网连接支持的可用区列表。在跨地域场景下，终端节点与终端节点服务两侧的可用区支持情况相互独立，本接口支持按终端节点侧和终端节点服务侧分别查询其支持的可用区列表

DetachResourceFromVpcEndpointService.description_en: Calls the DetachResourceFromVpcEndpointService operation to remove a service resource from an endpoint service
DetachResourceFromVpcEndpointService.description_zh: 调用DetachResourceFromVpcEndpointService接口，移除终端节点服务中的服务资源

DetachSecurityGroupFromVpcEndpoint.description_en: Removes an endpoint from a security group by calling the DetachSecurityGroupFromVpcEndpoint operation
DetachSecurityGroupFromVpcEndpoint.description_zh: 调用DetachSecurityGroupFromVpcEndpoint接口，将终端节点移除安全组

DisableVpcEndpointConnection.description_en: Rejects a connection request from an endpoint
DisableVpcEndpointConnection.description_zh: 调用DisableVpcEndpointConnection接口，拒绝终端节点的连接请求

DisableVpcEndpointZoneConnection.description_en: Calls the DisableVpcEndpointZoneConnection operation to disconnect an endpoint zone connection
DisableVpcEndpointZoneConnection.description_zh: 调用DisableVpcEndpointZoneConnection接口，断开终端节点可用区连接

EnableVpcEndpointConnection.description_en: Accepts an endpoint connection request for an endpoint service by calling the EnableVpcEndpointConnection operation
EnableVpcEndpointConnection.description_zh: 调用EnableVpcEndpointConnection接口，终端节点服务接受终端节点的连接请求

EnableVpcEndpointZoneConnection.description_zh: 调用EnableVpcEndpointZoneConnection接口，允许终端节点可用区连接

GetVpcEndpointAttribute.description_en: Retrieves the attributes of an endpoint
GetVpcEndpointAttribute.description_zh: 获取终端节点属性信息

GetVpcEndpointServiceAttribute.description_en: Queries the attributes of an endpoint service that belongs to the current account
GetVpcEndpointServiceAttribute.description_zh: 调用GetVpcEndpointServiceAttribute接口，查询归属当前账号的终端节点服务属性信息

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags that are bound to resources
ListTagResources.description_zh: 当您需要查询资源标签时，可调用ListTagResources接口，查询资源已经绑定的标签列表

ListVpcEndpointConnections.description_en: Queries endpoint connections by calling the ListVpcEndpointConnections operation
ListVpcEndpointConnections.description_zh: 调用ListVpcEndpointConnections接口，查询终端节点连接

ListVpcEndpointSecurityGroups.description_en: Calls the ListVpcEndpointSecurityGroups operation to query the security groups that are associated with an endpoint
ListVpcEndpointSecurityGroups.description_zh: 调用ListVpcEndpointSecurityGroups接口，查询终端节点已加入的安全组

ListVpcEndpointServiceResources.description_en: Queries the service resources that are added to an endpoint service
ListVpcEndpointServiceResources.description_zh: 调用ListVpcEndpointServiceResources接口查询终端节点服务中的服务资源

ListVpcEndpointServiceUsers.description_en: Queries the whitelist of an endpoint service
ListVpcEndpointServiceUsers.description_zh: 调用ListVpcEndpointServiceUsers接口，查询终端节点服务的服务白名单

ListVpcEndpointServices.description_en: Queries the list of endpoint services that belong to the current account
ListVpcEndpointServices.description_zh: 调用ListVpcEndpointServices接口，查询归属当前账号的终端节点服务列表

ListVpcEndpointServicesByEndUser.description_en: Invokes the ListVpcEndpointServicesByEndUser operation to query the endpoint services for which the current account is in the authorization whitelist. The results include services under the current account and other accounts. The results cover services that are active and can be associated when you create an endpoint, and services that are already associated with existing endpoints
ListVpcEndpointServicesByEndUser.description_zh: 调用ListVpcEndpointServicesByEndUser接口，查询当前账号处于授权白名单中的终端节点服务信息，包括当前账号及其他账号下的服务。涵盖可用于创建终端节点进行关联的服务，以及已创建的终端节点所关联的服务

ListVpcEndpointZones.description_en: Call the ListVpcEndpointZones operation to query the zones of an endpoint
ListVpcEndpointZones.description_zh: 调用ListVpcEndpointZones接口，查询终端节点可用区列表

RemoveUserFromVpcEndpointService.description_en: Calls the RemoveUserFromVpcEndpointService operation to remove a user account from the service whitelist of an endpoint service
RemoveUserFromVpcEndpointService.description_zh: 调用RemoveUserFromVpcEndpointService接口，移除终端节点服务的服务白名单

RemoveZoneFromVpcEndpoint.description_en: Deletes a zone of an endpoint
RemoveZoneFromVpcEndpoint.description_zh: 调用RemoveZoneFromVpcEndpoint接口，删除终端节点的可用区

TagResources.description_en: Adds tags to resources. You can call this API operation to add tags to one or more endpoints or endpoint services
TagResources.description_zh: 当您需要标识一个或多个终端节点或终端节点服务时，可调用TagResources接口，为指定的资源列表统一绑定标签

UntagResources.description_en: Removes tags from one or more endpoints or endpoint services at a time
UntagResources.description_zh: 当您不需要标识一个或多个终端节点或终端节点服务时，可调用UntagResources接口，为指定的资源列表统一解绑标签

UpdateVpcEndpointAttribute.description_en: Modifies the attributes of an endpoint
UpdateVpcEndpointAttribute.description_zh: 调用UpdateVpcEndpointAttribute接口，修改终端节点的属性

UpdateVpcEndpointConnectionAttribute.description_en: Calls the UpdateVpcEndpointConnectionAttribute operation to modify the attributes of an endpoint connection
UpdateVpcEndpointConnectionAttribute.description_zh: 调用UpdateVpcEndpointConnectionAttribute接口，修改终端节点连接的属性

UpdateVpcEndpointServiceAttribute.description_en: Calls the UpdateVpcEndpointServiceAttribute operation to modify the attributes of an endpoint service
UpdateVpcEndpointServiceAttribute.description_zh: 调用UpdateVpcEndpointServiceAttribute接口，修改终端节点服务的属性

UpdateVpcEndpointServiceResourceAttribut.description_en: The UpdateVpcEndpointServiceResourceAttribute operation enables or disables automatic allocation for a service resource of an endpoint service
UpdateVpcEndpointServiceResourceAttribut.description_zh: 调用UpdateVpcEndpointServiceResourceAttribute接口，修改终端节点服务资源是否自动分配

UpdateVpcEndpointZoneConnectionResourceA.description_en: Modifies a service resource of a zone to which an endpoint connection belongs
UpdateVpcEndpointZoneConnectionResourceA.description_zh: 调用UpdateVpcEndpointZoneConnectionResourceAttribute接口，替换终端节点可用区连接服务资源

endpoints.region_name_zh: 华北6（乌兰察布）通用行业云
